Cabàs is a free and open personal finance app, inspired by Kakebo and made first in Valencian.\n\nYour money, under control.

1. Tap Add transaction to record income or an expense. Pick the date on the calendar; expenses have a category. As you type the description, Cabàs suggests the ones you have used before and their category.

2. Tap any transaction to correct or delete it. Use the magnifying glass at the top to search transactions from any month.

3. Change month with the arrows. The category summary shows where your money goes and, if a category has a budget, how much is left.

4. In Plan this month, set a spending budget and a savings goal. You can copy last month’s plan.

5. In Menu → Recurring transactions, add what repeats every month. Cabàs records it on the chosen day.

6. At the end of the month, write the reflection with the four Kakebo questions. Menu → Trends shows how the months of the year compare.

7. In Menu → Backups and export, turn on the weekly automatic backup or make backups by hand.

8. In Menu → Settings you can change the theme, protect the app with your phone’s lock and turn on a daily reminder.

Tip: long-press the Cabàs icon to go straight to Add expense.

Cabàs works without Internet, accounts, bank connections, ads or telemetry.

Transactions, plans, categories, recurring transactions and reflections are stored only on the device. The database has no encryption of its own.

Android’s automatic backups are turned off so your data never leaves the phone unless you decide. Cabàs backups (manual or automatic) are saved only in the folder you choose. Backup and CSV files are not encrypted: treat them as personal documents.

The optional lock uses your phone’s fingerprint, face or PIN; Cabàs stores no password. With the lock on, the content is hidden in the recent apps list and screenshots are blocked.

The daily reminder is optional and only asks for notification permission when you turn it on.

The source code and licence buttons open the browser only when you tap them.
